author: Ben Janca
description: We learn more about World of Warcraft Forever from the devs at Blizzcon 2026 including more information and lore on the new race the Skyborne, as well as other updates and changes coming to the game.
title: WoW Forever – More Gameplay Details and Lore | Blizzcon 2026 Interview

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Diablo 4 is far from dead, but don't expect any new expansions for the game going forward. Instead, Blizzard is preparing to tell the darkest story yet in Diablo 5, one that required a new numbered game to properly reintroduce Diablo himself back to the series, following his defeat in 2012's Diablo 3. Currently aiming for a 2029 release, this would mean that players are in for a relatively short wait for a new Diablo game--compared to previous releases--as Diablo 5 will arrive a mere six years after Diablo 4.

Speaking to GameSpot at
title: Blizzard Says Diablo 5 Was Too Big To Be A Diablo 4 Expansion

author: Levi Winslow
description:
With the FPS Wardogs dominating the Steam charts, developer Bulkhead is paying close attention to the game's various systems. The studio recently dropped a new patch that makes some necessary changes for server stability, while confirming that the team has their eyes on cheaters and exploiters.

As part of Patch 0.11, which came out on September 14, Bulkhead announced that should any dogs of war take advantage of Wardogs' economy by farming servers, they'll find themselves either temporarily or permanently banned from the game.

"As an early access game, we’re not perfect, and we never will be," Bul
title: Wardogs Devs Are Watching Economy Cheaters Like Hawks

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
One of the big announcements at BlizzCon was WoW Forever, the next iteration of offering a classic-style WoW experience. Blizzard is hoping to draw players back to the OG WoW in a number of ways, including with the introduction of 1,000+ new quests. GameSpot caught up with Blizzard senior game designer Josh Greenfield to discuss this, along with why the game's OG quests--from 22 years ago--still resonate today.

If Blizzard is adding 1,000 more quests to WoW with the update, how many does that bring the game up to in total? It's a tricky question to answer, Greenfield said, in part because some of WoW's original quests are "tracking quests," but if you're counting "actual p
title: How WoW Forever Handles Its Massive Set Of New Quests

author: Evan Campbell
description:
The Crazy Taxi franchise isn't just getting a brand-new game next year; it's also getting a live-action movie. Netflix and Sega have announced a new partnership that will see a Crazy Taxi film coming to the streaming service in 2027. Dan Gregor and Doug Mand are penning the comedy's screenplay, after previously working together on Naked Gun (2025), Crazy Ex-Girlfriend, and How I Met Your Mother.

There's no director attached to the project, yet. However, Original Film's Neal H. Moritz and Toby Ascher are producing the Crazy Taxi movie, alongside Sonic the Hedgehog series producer Toru Nakahara. "This film is for anyone who's spent hours behind the wheel of a yellow cab on their Dreamcast, with the music cranked up, smashing through everything in sight just to make the next fare," said Moritz and Ascher in
title: Crazy Taxi Gets Crazier With Crazy Ex-Girlfriend Writers For New Movie

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Combat has grown massively between each numbered Diablo game, and for Diablo 5, Blizzard is aiming to once again elevate those gameplay mechanics to new heights.

"Fundamentally, we're an isometric action-RPG, and we're not looking to shake that up with Diablo 5," executive producer Matt Zitterman said to GameSpot at BlizzCon 2026. "We're looking to improve on it, evolve it, and we have some great, interesting ideas about how to make combat feel even more visceral, even more action-forward. Kind of continuing to build on the success of that fast combat that started in Diablo 3, improved in Diablo 4, and we want to take it even further in Diablo 5.&nbs
title: Diablo 5 Isn’t Reinventing The Combat Wheel, It’s Making It Spin Even Faster

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
If early iterations of characters had survived the development process, Tracer could have been a very different Overwatch hero. Speaking to GameSpot at BlizzCon 2026, game director Aaron Keller mentioned that he had been playing Overwatch since 2013, "since Tracer was shooting lasers out of her eyes."

When questioned about such a strange sequence of words, Keller explained that the bizarre version of Tracer came from the first days of Overwatch's engine development in late 2013.

"When we were creating the Overwatch engine, you know, so this is late 2013, the first day we got Tracer in we all ran around but we didn't actually have a projectile system yet," he added. "So when
title: Overwatch’s Tracer Once Shot Lasers From Her Eyes, And It Could Happen Again

author: Ben Janca
description:
The Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave game launches September 17, 2026, only on Nintendo Switch 2.

Travel through time to gather allies and defeat the demon god Balor. Test your tactical prowess in battle as you guide four heroes on their interwoven journeys from past to present. Together, you’ll save the future from ruin—or fall trying.

What is your favorite unit type from Fire Emblem?
title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave – Official Game Overview Trailer

author: Levi Winslow
description:
The hottest game on PC right now is Wardogs, the Battlefield-like mass multiplayer FPS by developer Bulkhead that's soaring up the Steam charts. While it may not be as hot as the game itself, the game's subreddit is full of hotheads demanding you do one teeny-tiny thing. Close. The. Doors. Behind. You.

Released in a closed beta state in August 2026 before entering early access in September 2026, Wardogs has taken PC gaming by storm. It's not only the number-one trending game according to SteamDB, with an all-time peak of 428,666 concurrent players on September 13, but it's also the fourth-most-played game on Steam, trailing behind Counter-Strike 2, Dota 2, and PUBG: Battlegrou
title: Wardogs Players Really Want You To Close The Doors … Or Else

author: Ben Janca
description:
Lies, conspiracies, and gossip. They make up the dense fog that obscures what really going down in this war. The legendary ace – Wings – is no different.

ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE releases October 2nd, 2026!

Pre-order now to unlock the F-14A aircraft and exclusive access to ACE COMBAT ZERO: THE BELKAN WAR.

The Deluxe Edition of ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE includes:

  • Base Game
  • 3 days of Early Access
  • Customizable Cosmetic Set
  • Premium Ace Pass Plus Voucher
title: Ace Combat 8: Wings Of Theve – Official Story Overview Trailer

author: Ben Janca
description:
Get a closer look at Kingmakers, the upcoming medieval action-strategy sandbox. In this Gameplay Deep Dive, the developers provide brand-new details on the game's story and key gameplay systems such as combat, settlement management, and RTS mechanics.

Go back in time to a war-torn medieval era with a vast arsenal of modern weapons, change the course of history, and save the future in Kingmakers. Build your kingdom, grab a gun, and lead an army of thousands into massive, real-time simulated battles — solo or in co-op.
title: Kingmakers – 12 Minute Gameplay Overview Deep Dive

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
One of the main collectibles in Marvel's Wolverine are Logan's whiskey bottles. These will grant you AP that can be spent on unlocking Adaptations. In Marvel's Wolverine, these Adaptations work like a skill tree, unlocking new abilities for Logan to slash his way through each level with.

There may be light spoilers around characters that appear throughout the story, although we've taken care to not reveal major plot details that surround their locations. We've split the whiskey bottles up by the mission that they appear in. Don't forget that you can interact with the bed in the Nightmare Trials cabin to replay missions if you miss any.

There are no whiskey bottles in the first three missions--Back In Action, A Debt Repaid, and Last Meal--and you can't miss the first one as it's part of the sto
title: All Marvel’s Wolverine Whiskey Bottle Locations

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
The Triple-I Initiative Showcase is officially coming back on October 8 at 9 AM PT / 12 PM ET, and this second instalment of the show will once again offer plenty of trailers and announcements from a wide variety of publishers and developers. Since the first presentation kicked off in 2024, the Triple-I Initiative has been an annual event, but the organizers say they have even more to show next month with a second dose of back-to-back video game trailers.

Viewers can expect eight exclusive world premieres from studios such as Team17, Amanita Design, Strange Scaffold, and Norsfell, as well as reveals for Dave the Diver, Brotato, Chained Together, Risk of Rain 2, and Windrose. The showcase will run for around 45 minutes, and there'll also be news for games like Hela: of Mice and Magic, Militsioner, the new Among Us title, Pony Island 2: Panda Circus, Haunted Paws, and&n
title: The Triple-I Initiative Showcase Is Getting A Second Event In 2026

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Naughty Dog's The Last of Us franchise featured a multiplayer mode in Factions, and while the studio planned to add multiplayer to the sequel, it abandoned those ambitions before release. A modder spent months this year working on a multiplayer mod for The Last of Us 2, but its lead has now said it's not going to be released due to a request from Sony to shut it down.

Modder @Speclizer_ said on social media that the mod was due to launch this month. However, they said they "recently received a letter on behalf of Sony Interactive Entertainment requesting for the mod not to be released."
title: The Last Of Us 2 Multiplayer Mod Canceled “On Behalf Of Sony,” Dev Says

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Actor Roger Clark played Arthur Morgan in Rockstar's celebrated 2018 Western Red Dead Redemption 2, and his performance was memorable for many reasons. In the game, Arthur suffers from tuberculosis, and he coughs a lot as a result. Was it challenging for Clark to perform those sequences in particular? Yes, but it was "not as bad as you'd think," Clark said in a recent interview, in part because sometimes Clark recorded when he himself had a bad cough.

Clark told Cade Onder that he had "five years to spread it out," regarding his voice-capture performance in Red Dead 2, and that's part of the reason why it wasn't as difficult as you might imagine. Additionally, Clark said if he was performing a "really bad coughing scene," this would be saved for the end of a given recording day, when his voi
title: Red Dead 2 Actor Shares A Gross Secret About The Game

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description: Lies of P was a big hit when it was first released, and several years after it was confirmed that a sequel was in development, a new trademark by developer Neowiz has popped up online. As spotted on the European Union Intellectual Property Office website (via ResetEra), the studio has registered a trademark for "Wonders of O," suggesting that the game will put own macabre spin on L. Frank Baum's The Wonderful
title: Lies Of P’s Wizard Of Oz Tease May Have Just Gotten A Lot More Interesting

author: Cameron Koch
description:
Diablo 5 will launch with more classes than any other game in the franchise, according to game director Joe Shely.

Shely revealed more details about what to expect from Diablo 5's launch roster during a BlizzCon 2026 panel, following the game's surprise reveal (and Spring 2029 release window) as part of BlizzCon's opening ceremony. During the panel, Blizzard revealed three of Diablo 5's classes: Monk, Demon Hunter, and the new Plague Knight.

"Diablo 5 is going to launch with more classes than ever before," Shely said. "And I don't just mean more
title: Diablo 5 Will Have The Most Classes Of Any Game In The Series

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
On paper, Zach Cregger directing a Resident Evil movie sounds like a smart move. The director has earned critical acclaim for his work on spooky flicks like Barbarian and Weapons, while Resident Evil is experiencing a resurgence thanks to several years of hit games. But that's a pairing that almost never came to be, as after the dismal box office performance of 2021's Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City, movie distributor Constantin Films--who own the film rights to Resident Evil-- wanted to give the franchise a chance to rest before greenlighting a new project.

That all changed when Cregger approached the company, as Constantin Films CEO Oliver Berben said that he already had ideas in mind for the Resident Evil movie he wanted to make. This was prior to the release of W
title: Resident Evil Movies Were On Ice Until Zach Cregger Came Along

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Marvel's Wolverine puts you in the claws of Logan in a game developed by Insomniac Games. Throughout this original story, Logan must fight to protect mutants and humans alongside Team X--the same Team X he left three years prior to the game's events. If you're wondering whether to dip your toe into the latest installment, we've got all you need to know on how long Marvel's Wolverine takes to beat, and the full mission list.

How long to beat Marvel's Wolverine

Marvel's Wolverine takes between 20 and 25 hours to fully complete, including finishing the main campaign, and finding all of the collectibles, Nightmare Trial Doors, and more.

However, it's important to note that you will experience fluctuations on this estimate depending on the difficulty level you played at, or if you're looking
title: How Long To Beat Marvel’s Wolverine – Full Mission List

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
The Resident Evil movie from Barbarian and Weapons director Zach Cregger releases on September 18, and now he's revealed a key detail about what people won't experience in the movie. Speaking to The Hollywood Reporter, Cregger shared what he learned from test screenings, and that was that an earlier version had too much humor.

People who saw Barbarian and Weapons know that those spooky movies had humor sprinkled in, and Cregger himself comes from a comedy background with his role in the sketch comedy group Whitest Kids 'U Know. He and co-writer Shay Hatten apparently imbued a bit too much comedy in Resident Evil, so they dialed thin
title: Release The Resident Evil: Whitest Kids ‘U Know Cut

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Wardogs has released into early access, seeing concurrent player numbers soar over 300,000 on launch day. With its immense popularity, many are on the fence about buying the title, wondering if their PC setup can handle it. With the console launch of Wardogs yet to receive an official release date, is it worth grabbing Wardogs even if your PC isn't top spec?

Luckily, Wardogs isn't super demanding on your system, meaning that many setups should be able to run it without significant issues. As expected, there's a bit of a jump from minimum to recommended requirements, but with the Nvidia 30-series falling in the recommended specs, it's potentially worth taking the risk if you're not on a high-end PC. Remember that you can refund games on Steam that you've played for less than two hours if you do end up facing technical difficulties.<
title: Wardogs PC Specifications And System Requirements

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Marvel's Wolverine is the next action-adventure title from Insomniac Games, and features Logan rejoining Team X in a bid to protect mutants. There's plenty of combat-focused action, but there are also things you might not know before you play.

We've got plenty of tips to help you in your quests as Wolverine, including combat pointers, how best to explore each area, the systems and mechanics to pay attention to, and more.
title: Marvel’s Wolverine Tips To Know Before You Play

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
Amidst a flurry of rumors and teases, a brand-new StarCraft game was officially revealed at BlizzCon 2026. While the series started off as a real-time strategy experience, the new StarCraft is switching gears and has been billed as an open-world shooter. While it won't be out for several more years, Blizzard did reveal several details about the game, along with a slick cinematic trailer to set the stage for what's to come. Here's a closer look at everything we know about StarCraft so far.

StarCraft release date
title: StarCraft: Release Date, Gameplay, And Everything We Know

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Resident Evil movie director Zach Cregger has shared his thoughts on the ongoing debate and discussion about physical media in games. He wasn't speaking directly about Sony's decision to end support for physical game discs in 2028, but rather commenting generally on the matter.

Speaking to IndieWire, Cregger said he is "not a physical media guy" today. He said he was previously, but he is a person who often loses or damages the physical media he owns, and he doesn't have enou
title: Resident Evil Movie Director Comments On Physical Media Debate

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
There's been speculation for months over who could be voicing the GTA 6 cast, but nothing has been officially confirmed, either by developer Rockstar or any of the starring talents, until now.

At the BAFTA TV Tea Party, held at The Maybourne Beverly Hills in California, actor Stephen Root was attending in support of his Emmy nomination for his role as Wyck in Apple's Widow's Bay. However, when asked about the rumors around his involvement in GTA 6, Root confirmed (via AP) that he does appear in the game.

"Yeah, you're going to see me in there," he confirmed. "I think from the first rollout of GTA that they were doing almost a year ago they had my character in the
title: First GTA 6 Actor Officially Confirmed, And It’s A Big Name

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
Over the weekend, Wardogs hit a mammoth peak concurrent count of over 425,000. Today, the game is undergoing scheduled maintenance to improve the server browser experience for players. The servers will be down on Monday, 14 September from 1 AM PT / 4 AM ET / 9 AM GMT for approximately one hour while the patch is deployed. Here's everything included in that patch and what it means for your Wardogs experience.

Server Browser Improvements

In the patch notes, Wardogs developer Bulkhead acknowledges that the server browsing experience hasn't been as good as it should be. "Community servers have been underserved, and the server browser experience as a whole has been poor," the developer writes. "It is clear to us that we have not put the same amount of care and passi
title: Wardogs Patch Notes – Scheduled Maintenance And Patch 0.11

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Wardogs has been released into early access on PC. This is a large-scale tactical warfare game, where you can play various roles in order to help your team score enough points to reach a victory. In this guide, we'll explain how matches of Wardogs are played and how you can earn points for your team.

Wardogs matches explained

This game features matches with large teams fighting for control of a circular "Control Zone" designated on the map. The goal is to have your team hold the majority in this zone in order to score points. About every 30 seconds, the team with the most players in this Control Zone will earn one point, and the first team to 100 wins.
title: How To Win Matches In Wardogs

author: S.E. Doster
description:
Wardogs has officially launched in early access, and while it doesn't feature class-specific roles like Battlefield, there are several different skill branches you can level up to make yourself more efficient. In this guide, we'll explain each skill type in Wardogs and how to level each one.

How skills work in Wardogs
title: How To Level Up Each Skill In Wardogs
